effects.description: After holding down the normal attack button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo and the 2nd hit of the attack changes: 89% recovery of damage given (up to 2500). Reduces damage taken by 70% and reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the button is held down. Deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain period of time or when the normal attack button is released. Adds the amount of reduced damage received from enemies while the normal attack button is held down to the damage dealt to enemies. However, any damage reduced by other Trait effects will not be added.
